title: POC Deployment Sprint Cadence and Risk Tracker
content:
Executive summary:
This note captures a proposed 4-sprint cadence for a mid-size customer POC (Customer X), the task tracker for activities during each sprint, workshop highlights, acceptance criteria, and a compact risk tracker for go/no-go decisions. The goal is to produce a validated deployment proposal, an integration demo, and a handoff package for the customer infra team within 8 weeks.

Goals and success metrics:
- Functional integration: end-to-end request flow from customer app -> Redwood Private (VPC) -> model serving, verified with sample traffic.
- Latency SLO: p50 < 150ms for single-turn prompts under demo load; p95 < 350ms.
- Cost estimate validated: projected $/1000 tokens within 15% of forecast.
- Security & compliance: network diagram reviewed and KMS key handshake validated.
- Acceptance: customer sign-off on performance tests and a single production-like workload replay.

Scope (what's in/out):
- Included: model selection (open model), deployment automation (terraform snippets), basic cache/batching config, observability hooks (tracing + per-route metrics), and a 2-hour internal demo.
- Excluded: custom model fine-tuning, long-term retention policies, and contractual SLA negotiation (handled by AMs).

Workshop notes (synthesis):
- 2025-11-10 kickoff workshop summary: Customer has strict VPC peering requirements and wants predictable throughput for business-hours peak (20 RPS). They asked for estimate on warm-start latency and op cost for 5M tokens/day.
- Key decisions made: use quantized 4-bit model variant for cost; Dedicated tenant preferred for isolation; data plane must not exit customer VPC.
- Open questions: exact token distribution (avg / max), expected concurrency bursts, and whether customer can provide a sample replay dataset (requested).

Proposed sprint cadence (high level):
- Sprint 0 (Prep, 1 week) 2025-11-17 -> 2025-11-21: onboarding, infra checklist, obtain credentials, network diagram finalized, initial terraform repo scaffolded.
- Sprint 1 (Integration, 2 weeks) 2025-11-24 -> 2025-12-05: deploy private control plane, model artifact provisioning, basic inference endpoint, smoke tests.
- Sprint 2 (Performance tuning & observability, 3 weeks) 2025-12-08 -> 2025-12-26: configure batching/caching, run synthetic load tests, implement dashboards and tracing, quantify cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Sprint 3 (Validation & handoff, 2 weeks) 2026-01-05 -> 2026-01-16: run customer replay, finalize runbook, demo to customer, capture acceptance signoff, create handoff artifacts.

Compact task tracker (owner | due | status | notes):
- Ava Martinez | 2025-11-21 | done | Provision initial terraform skeleton and share repo link.
tasks: Ravi Patel | 2025-11-24 | in_progress | Set up VPC peering test on staging and validate routes
Elena Chen | 2025-12-05 | todo | Push model artifact (quantized) and validate checksum/verifier
Marcus Liu | 2025-12-12 | todo | Run load harness: 20 RPS baseline, 100 concurrent burst scenario
Priya Desai | 2026-01-09 | todo | Prepare customer demo deck and script; coordinate demo timing
Samir Khan | 2025-12-01 | in_progress | Implement tracing hooks and initial dashboards in Redwood Console
risks: R1 | Network restrictions prevent peering -> Mitigation: offer relay-proxy design or air-gapped appliance; owner: Ravi | impact: high
R2 | Customer cannot share sample replay -> Mitigation: synthetic replay using inferred token distribution; owner: Marcus | impact: medium
R3 | Quantized model quality regression -> Mitigation: A/B test with baseline fp16; rollback plan required; owner: Elena | impact: high
R4 | Scheduling delays from customer infra -> Mitigation: parallelize tasks that don't require their access; owner: Ava | impact: medium
acceptance_criteria: 1) End-to-end demo runs with customer-provided app or validated replay without manual intervention
2) Latency SLOs met in demo environment (p50/p95 targets) or documented tradeoffs with mitigations
3) Cost projection within 15% of measured during synthetic replay
4) Runbook and terraform module reviewed and merged to customer repo or shared workspace
meeting_notes: Kickoff 2025-11-10: Customer emphasized need for audit logs and KMS integration; action: schedule security sync (Ava)
Tech deep-dive 2025-11-18: Discussed batching window and impact on tail latency; decided to tune batching policy per-route
Mid-POC sync 2025-12-15: Early perf runs show p95 ~420ms; scope for micro-optimizations identified (kernel selection, KV cache sizing)
next_steps: 1) Confirm replay dataset delivery date by 2025-11-21. 2) Finalize sprint owners and update JIRA tickets. 3) Book dry-run demo with internal stakeholders on 2026-01-10. 4) Prepare short postmortem template to capture learnings and recommended Redwood config presets for similar customers.
notes_to_self: Keep delivery triage list short. If network issues consume >2 workdays, escalate to solutions-eng lead and propose the relay-proxy option immediately.
